country.match: Match each dessert to the country it comes from.
country.odd: Three of these desserts come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

rows.label: mooncake
rows.description: Chinese bakery product traditionally eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival
rows.hook: is traditionally given and eaten at a harvest festival in early autumn

rows.label: tiramisu
rows.hook: layers coffee-soaked ladyfingers with mascarpone cream and a cocoa dusting

rows.label: Turkish delight
rows.hook: is a chewy starch-and-sugar gel sweet, often rosewater-flavoured and dusted with powdered sugar

rows.label: pastel de nata
rows.description: Portuguese egg tart pastry dusted with cinnamon

rows.label: mochi
rows.description: Japanese rice cake made of mochigome
rows.hook: is a chewy treat pounded from steamed glutinous rice, traditional at New Year

rows.label: cannoli
rows.hook: is a fried pastry tube stuffed with sweet ricotta cream

rows.label: affogato
rows.hook: is a scoop of ice cream drowned in a shot of hot espresso

rows.label: mille-feuille
rows.hook: layers puff pastry with pastry cream and is called a Napoleon in North America

rows.label: panna cotta
rows.description: Italian dessert made by blending cream, sugar and gelatin
rows.hook: is sweetened cream set with gelatin into a wobbly moulded pudding

rows.label: Black Forest cake
rows.description: type of chocolate cake, traditionally made with "kirschwasser", a brandy made from double distillation of morello cherries
rows.hook: layers chocolate sponge with cherries, kirsch and whipped cream

rows.label: gelato
rows.hook: is dense, slow-churned ice cream with less air and butterfat than other styles

rows.label: stroopwafel
rows.description: two round waffle-like wafers with a caramel filling in the middle
rows.hook: sandwiches two thin baked wafers around gooey caramel syrup, often warmed over a hot drink

rows.label: speculoos biscuit
rows.description: Belgian caramel biscuit, with a different recipe than traditional speculaas
rows.hook: is a crunchy, spiced caramel-brown cookie often blended into a sweet spread

rows.label: Banoffee pie
rows.hook: pairs bananas with thick toffee-like caramel and whipped cream on a crumbly base

rows.label: tarte Tatin
rows.description: pastry with caramelised fruit that originated in France
rows.hook: is baked with caramelised apples that end up on top once it is flipped over

rows.label: Kaiserschmarrn
rows.description: sweet Austrian dish, similar to a shredded pancake

rows.label: Sachertorte
rows.description: specific type of chocolate cake, or torte
rows.hook: is a chocolate sponge with apricot jam under a glossy glaze, long fought over by two Vienna rivals

rows.label: macaron
rows.hook: is a colourful almond-meringue sandwich cookie with a ruffled edge at the base

rows.label: madeleine
rows.description: type of cake traditional from France
rows.hook: is a small shell-shaped sponge cake that triggered a famous novelist's childhood memories

rows.label: Nanaimo bar
rows.hook: is a no-bake three-layer treat of crumb base, custard icing and chocolate

rows.label: dango
rows.hook: is a rice-flour dumpling served three to five to a skewer
